name: task-state-with-files
description: Keep substantive agent task state in relative owner-readable files and restore it through supported host lifecycle events.

interface.shortDescription: Recover long-task state from local files.
interface.longDescription: Adds a reusable Skill for file-backed task state and a non-blocking SessionStart Hook that restores relative local state after startup, resume, clear, or compaction.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $task-state-with-files to keep this substantive task recoverable across compaction and resume.
